verified_discrepancies_and_notes: Actual PLL clock in dmesg is 535.000 MHz CPU / 400 MHz DDR / 200 MHz AHB (ToH table states 533 MHz).
AR9342 internal 2.4 GHz WMAC is unpopulated on LAP-120 (ath9k probe fails with -5); populated on LAP-GPS alongside GPS UART.
SPI NOR write-protection bug affected OpenWrt 23.05.0..23.05.2 and 24.10.0..24.10.2 (PR #14361 / #17287); fixed in 24.10.3+ and verified on our bench with OpenWrt 24.10.4 (Linux 6.6.110).
Actual CPU frequency in dmesg is 535.000 MHz (ToH page table erroneously lists 560 MHz).
Includes secondary AR9340 2.4 GHz management radio (phy1, irq=47) where PAPRD calibration fails and auto-disables.
Stock airOS 8 CPE uses 4-addr WDS with inner ETH_P_TEB (0x6558) encapsulation requiring mac80211 0x6558 strip or allow_80211=1 + ubnt_op_mode=0.
Canonical OpenWrt wiki URL is toh/ubiquiti/litebeam_5ac_gen2 (not litebeam_ac_gen2).
U-Boot bootm LZMA ERROR 1 on larger kernels when loaded to 0x81000000; requires tftpboot 0x82000000.
Completely missing from OpenWrt ToH (toh/ubiquiti/rocket_ac only documents the older AR9342 64MB R5AC-Lite).

Features three radio interfaces: wifi0 (QCA9880 5GHz + Dual-Stage AirPrism active filter on SPI/GPIO 14-15 + IRQ 64 blanking), wifi1 (QCA9558 2.4GHz management WMAC), and airview1 (dedicated spectral scanner VAP).

Couples a QCA9880 802.11ac VHT20/40 baseband to a 2.4 GHz RF downconverter and 2.4 GHz hardware AirPrism active filter (>35.5 dB adjacent-channel rejection, IRQ 64 blanking at 35..80 IRQ/s) plus wifi1 management radio and airview1.

PBE-M5-400 (0xe4e5) uses an external AR8035 Gigabit PHY, whereas PBE-M5-300 (0xe3e5) uses the internal AR9342 FastEthernet (100M) switch (ATHRS27). Flashing ubnt_powerbeam-m5-xw onto PBE-M5-300 breaks eth0; PBE-M5-300 requires ubnt_nanobeam-m5-xw.
XW.v6.3.x U-Boot urescue attempts DHCP before falling back to 192.168.1.20.
Requires downgrade to AirOS XM.v5.5.x before flashing OpenWrt because AirOS 5.6+ shifted MTD partition offsets.
Single physical Ethernet port enumerates as eth1 (not eth0) on OpenWrt ath79.

fleet_toh_audit.soc: Altera/Intel Cyclone V SoC (Dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 HPS + FPGA fabric)
verified_discrepancies_and_notes: Not an Atheros/Qualcomm ath79 or QCA988x device; uses Cyclone V ARM HPS + proprietary ame_core.ko FPGA baseband (up to 4096-QAM, 12 bits/symbol) and 8-queue eth0 mq DMA.
LTU-Lite (0xae08) ame_core.ko natively supports role=ap in both wireless_mode=ptp and wireless_mode=ptmp (including Short-Queue SQ mode for 0 < ptmp_max_cpe <= 16).
